scope: The latest R8C NE/NW world-grid captures were opened and reviewed frame-by-frame in the existing planning conversation. Earlier R7 static/fixed evidence was used only as a continuity reference. This is not an eight-direction or production promotion review.

promotion.remaining_gate: Godot/runtime integration, eight-direction sector/package gate, and final promotion review

specific_findings.gait: NE/NW read as diagonal forward stance-swing walking with clear left/right alternation, not in-place tap dancing or blocking skate motion.
specific_findings.leg_separation: R7 left/right separation remains; blocking leg crossing and persistent duck-foot/out-toed recurrence were not observed.
specific_findings.scale_and_volume: No rubber-leg stretch, non-uniform pumping, barrel-calf expansion, or waist snap observed across 120 frames.
specific_findings.foot_and_ground: No blocking 90-degree ankle, boot inversion, gross foot snap, visible ground penetration, or floating support sole observed.
specific_findings.sole_and_handoff: Both support windows remain visually locked; F11->F12 and F23->F00 handoffs and stride balance remain continuous.
specific_findings.raster_cadence: R7 complete stop and large catch-up pulse are resolved in R8C; no blocking stop-and-catch-up is visible. Small cadence modulation remains non-blocking.
specific_findings.composite: Torso/hip/coat/weapon connection, front-back z-order, green/alpha seams, halo, and flicker remain stable.
non_blocking_polish: Some phases read as a slightly wide, rigid tactical stride.
Heel-to-toe roll and pelvis counter-motion remain subtle; swing-foot clearance is restrained.
Subpixel residual causes very slight edge sharpness modulation.
NE and NW cycle advance is not numerically identical and must be compared under the final game-speed gate.
